title: Canonical constant/roots cup on ordinary finite-coefficient cohomology
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $N\in\mathbf N$. Put $R=\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z$, using its universe lift when necessary. In the category of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let $R_X$ be the constant rank-one module and let $U$ forget the module structure. This forgetful functor is additive and preserves finite limits, finite colimits and sheafification; it canonically identifies $U(R_X)$ with the existing constant sheaf $\mathbf Z/N$. For an $R$-module sheaf $M$, let
$$\kappa^q_M:\operatorname{Ext}^q_{R_X}(R_X,M)\longrightarrow H^q(X,U(M))$$
be coefficient forgetting followed by precomposition with the constant integer unit $\mathbf Z_X\to R_X$, with ordinary cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. These comparisons are bijections; write their uniquely determined inverses as $\kappa_M^{-1}$. The existing roots-of-unity sheaf $\mu_N$ [def-sc-kummer-sequence], with its sectionwise exponent action [def-pur-kummer-module-coefficients], is itself an $R$-module sheaf (the module presheaf satisfies descent). For $p,q\geq0$ and $p+q=r$, define the canonical cup
$$H^p(X,\mathbf Z/N)\times H^q(X,\mu_N)\longrightarrow H^r(X,\mu_N)$$
by transport of the Yoneda action on module-sheaf Ext: lift both inputs through $\kappa$, compose the unit self-extension followed by the module extension, and transport the result by $\kappa_{\mu_N}^r$. With the left-then-right shifted-composition convention, multiply this composite by $(-1)^{pq}$ to obtain the unsigned Cech front/back convention. This is the ordinary derived global-sections cup followed by the coefficient evaluation $(\mathbf Z/N)\otimes\mu_N\to\mu_N$, $a\otimes z\mapsto z^a$.
